name: Articulated desk lamp
description: A weighted desk lamp with a swivel base, two hinged arms and a tilting shade, so you can aim the light anywhere on the desk.
how_it_works: The heavy steel base keeps the centre of gravity low, so the lamp doesn't tip when the arm reaches forward.
The swivel turns the whole arm around the vertical axis to point at a different part of the desk.
The shoulder hinge leans the lower arm forward or back; the elbow hinge raises or lowers the upper arm.
The head hinge tilts the shade so the bulb shines straight down on whatever is under it.
Pressing the push switch on the base turns the bulb on and off.
assumptions: Hinges are friction hinges (tight enough to hold their angle), so no springs are modelled.

parts.name: Rubber foot pad
parts.role: Grips the desk and stops scratches

parts.name: Weighted base
parts.role: Heavy steel disc that keeps the lamp from tipping over

parts.name: Push switch
parts.role: Turns the bulb on and off

parts.name: Swivel turret
parts.role: Bearing that lets the whole arm rotate around the base

parts.name: Shoulder hinge
parts.role: Friction hinge the lower arm pivots on

parts.name: Lower arm
parts.role: Lifts the head up above the desk

parts.name: Elbow hinge
parts.role: Friction hinge between the two arms

parts.name: Shade
parts.role: Cone that directs the light downward and hides the bulb from your eyes
